data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50 to reproduce, and start next month back at 100. That’s $10,000 apiece every month if we stick together. I propose we agree to that limit and check the stock and everyone’s catches each month. John, what do you think?
